name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
briefDescription: Provides a one-time financial incentive of up to ₹15,000 to first-time employees to support them during their initial learning phase and financial literacy course completion.
descriptionMd: This component of the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana offers a one-time incentive to new employees. It aims to assist them through their initial learning curve, helping them become fully productive after completing a financial literacy course. The scheme addresses the challenge new employees face in their early career by providing financial support.
benefitsMd:
- One-time financial incentive of up to ₹15,000/-
- Support for navigating the initial learning curve
- Assistance for completing a financial literacy course over the EPO portal
eligibilityMd:
- Must be a first-time employee.
- Required to complete a financial literacy course over the EPO portal.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
